name: lab-automation
description: LabFlow - laboratory automation for monthly sample registration, media preparation and autoclave log books

scripts.setup: node scripts/init-env.cjs && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev
